summary: Forecasts when each disk will fill, from the rate it has been filling over the last month.
does: Disk forecast measures how full each disk is once an hour and keeps one reading a day. It compares today with the oldest day it kept, up to 35 days back, and assumes the disk carries on filling at that rate.
The card gives one line for each disk, such as how many days until it is full. A disk that has not grown says how full it is instead. It only reads and never changes or deletes anything.
for: People who run a home server and want early warning that a disk is filling, before downloads or recordings stop working.
needs: Nothing else. It reads disk use from Starboard. A forecast needs readings from two different days, so the first day says measuring or not growing.
shows: One dashboard card, Disk forecast, with a line for each disk. Its status shows OK, Filling fast when a disk fills in under 60 days, and Problem when a disk fills in under 14 days. It has no settings and no buttons.
